purpose: Teach: やみ/がかっ/もしや/ヒロシ/ひろし/ひろ/いじり/ココ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、やみ市場に手を出してはいけない
lines.en: We cannot venture into the underground market.
lines.style: Measured authority. Quiet weight behind each word. Slight pause between clauses—this is not negotiable. Steady eye contact. Not harsh, but unmistakable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、青がかった色を採用しました
lines.en: Yes. We've adopted a blue-tinted color for the new product line.
lines.style: Clear, methodical acknowledgment. Reciting the action taken with straightforward professionalism. Even pacing. Respectful without excess deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もしや、と思った提案も検討しろ
lines.en: Even the proposals I was uncertain about—consider those too.
lines.style: A slight lean forward. Softer than the first statement—this invites thinking, not obedience. Curiosity underneath the direction. Conversational but still authoritative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、ヒロシ・コンサルティングと提携検討中です
lines.en: Yes. We're currently considering a partnership with Hiroshi Consulting.
lines.style: Providing information without inflection. Steady, factual tone. Brief pause before the company name—showing he's attending carefully to what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ひろし新事業を進めるべしと考えている
lines.en: I believe we should proceed with expanding into new business areas.
lines.style: Conviction without volume. Measured pace—each phrase landing with intent. Not commanding, but expressing a clear position. Slight exhale on 'believe.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ひろい層に届くキャンペーンを企画しております
lines.en: Understood. We're planning a campaign to reach a broader audience.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment followed by the update. Professional efficiency. Voice stays level and engaged. Brief, clear—the rhythm of someone keeping up with direction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員に、商品をいじり過ぎないよう伝えろ
lines.en: Tell the staff not to over-modify the products.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Not accusatory, but clear instruction. Slight emphasis on 'over-modify'—a gentle warning. The tone of someone who's seen this mistake before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗のココスタジオ、本日オープンしました
lines.en: Understood. Our new Koko Studio location opened today.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet pride. Even pace, understated. The final update before the conversation settles—neutral but present, acknowledging the milestone without overemphasis.
